title: Salt Lake City Sunset Bike and Brothel Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
A minimum of 4 people per tour is required, but only 2 people per booking. This means you may get grouped with another tour.
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Sunset Bike and Brothel Tour is an exploratory tour on bicycles, usually 3.5 hours long, beginning in the early evening, and giving a comprehensive look at Salt Lake City as the Crossroads of the West, and an extra focus on different areas of interest concerning prostitution history in the City. Groups ride bikes to all points of interest in the greater downtown area, historical and current. Multiple stops along the way for breaks, photos, and good old rest. Together, we gain an excellent vantage point of the City and enjoy a sparkling beverage together, provided by your guide. Questions are fielded by your personal, friendly, and locally-based tour guide. Stopping for a bite to eat is always an option.

We provide bicycles, helmets, and water in bottles to drink.
